criteria.requirement: Add public sort_dict_by_keys and sort_dict_by_values in pydash.objects and top-level exports. Accept Mapping, return a new insertion-ordered dict, support optional key and reverse, stable ties, exact key/value pairing and original value identity. Source order/content never mutate; falsey callable keys still execute, invalid input/key and comparison errors propagate clearly. Existing sort_by/objects API unchanged; do not promise chain methods without implementing their static interface.
